n: Raspberry Pi 5 local chatbot (Arm Learning Path)
t: An Arm Learning Path for running a small chatbot offline on a Raspberry Pi 5.
steps: Find the Run a local LLM chatbot on a Raspberry Pi 5 path.
Gather a Raspberry Pi 5 and a computer with an SD card slot.
Download the quantized Orca Mini model from Hugging Face.
Run the chatbot script and then go offline.
